Forest-green wool hooded courier cloak with narrow muted ochre edge, closed at the upper chest by a readily visible simple warm brass clasp shaped like a single quill. He holds one recognizably cylindrical tightly rolled parchment scroll across his chest and close to his body in a naturally drawn right hand, with tied simple leather cord, no lettering or seal needed. Other hand resting naturally, no second prop. Quiet sheltered angle of the dispatch courtyard in image 3 with a light grey stone arch to one side and muted dark oak post behind.
